case_counting_methodology.description: Case-level metrics are calculated after deduplicating records using safetyreportid.

reaction_counting_methodology.description: Reaction-frequency metrics count MedDRA Preferred Term occurrences from the source reaction field. These counts are not unique-case counts.

outcome_counting_methodology.description: Outcome metrics are reaction-level because a safety case can contain multiple reactions and outcomes.
